stories.title: Keeping it in the Pack: NC State eyes Rivers as top coach candidate, sources say
stories.summary: NC State has identified former Wolfpack and NFL quarterback Philip Rivers as its top candidate to be the school's next football coach, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Georgia returns to No. 1 in AP Top 25; Buckeyes' fall continues down to No. 21
stories.summary: Georgia took No. 1 in the latest AP Top 25 rankings for the second time this season after Miami's loss to Notre Dame, while Ohio State has fallen from No. 2 two weeks ago to No. 21 after a home loss to Oregon.

stories.title: Sources: Five-star OT recruit Matthews decommits from Texas A&M; Miami lurking
stories.summary: Five-star offensive tackle Mark Matthews, No. 6 in the SC Next ESPN 300, has decommitted from Texas A&M as Miami looms as a possible landing spot, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: DeChambeau: No regrets about LIV move, next steps will be made in 'right way'
stories.summary: Bryson DeChambeau said Sunday his "passion" remains trying to grow the game of golf, even if he now must go at it without LIV Golf.

stories.title: Carrick adamant he deserves to keep job with Man United in relegation zone
stories.summary: Michael Carrick has insisted there's enough evidence that he should keep his job despite Manchester United sitting in the Premier League relegation zone.
